entry.title: TON-618 is stranger than we think...

media:group.media:title: TON-618 is stranger than we think...
media:group.media:description:
Abacus AI’s ChatLLM gives you ChatGPT, Gemini Pro, Claude Opus, and more in one place. RouteLLM picks the best model for each prompt, plus AI image, video, and presentation tools. Only $10/month: https://chatllm.abacus.ai/wha
is not normal. It’s a monster... the biggest black hole in the known universe. You might THINK all black holes form when stars run out of fuel and collapse, and grow by pulling in surrounding matter. But there's not enough time, in the history of the universe for TON-618 to have formed like that.
Its discovery is a crisis in our understanding of blackholes. Just how big is TON-618? How do we know it's impossible? And could all this, actually hold the secret to understanding dark matter?

entry.title: What If Betelgeuse Replaced Our Sun? #Betelgeuse #Sun #SolarSystem #Space #Shorts

media:group.media:title: What If Betelgeuse Replaced Our Sun? #Betelgeuse #Sun #SolarSystem #Space #Shorts
media:group.media:description:
You can fit over a MILLION Earths inside our Sun. But you could squeeze over a BILLION Suns into the absolutely gigantic star named Betelgeuse. Betelgeuse is an unstable red supergiant that's rapidly pushing into its final fusion cycles before it detonates in an extremely violent supernova.
You really wouldn’t want to see this in our neighborhood. If Betelgeuse replaced our Sun, it would swallow half the Solar System. And that's before it explodes. Would you survive? Well, it ain't looking so good for you, but let's find out.

media:group.media:description:
